annotations.title: Find creators on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Vimeo

description: Creators from YouTube and Vimeo search words, or YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Vimeo profile links: followers, video count, average views, likes and comments over the latest posts, engagement rate, last post date, country, bio, website, other social accounts, public emails and a lead score. No login. Useful for influencer marketing, sponsorship outreach and creator research. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/creator-finder on your Apify account (about $0.002 per creator, $0.001 per video or post; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

links.description: YouTube, Instagram, TikTok or Vimeo profile or video links.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

min_engagement_rate.description: Lowest engagement rate in percent, e.g. 2.

posts_per_creator.description: Latest videos or posts to add per creator (also used for averages).

queries.description: Search words for YouTube and Vimeo, e.g. ["home barista"].

name: find_creators

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Find creators on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Vimeo
